# LuxiSize v0.2 binaries (unsigned)

**Sizing calculator included with the free LuxiBook download** - not the LuxiQuant Risk State Engine, not the LuxiBook
option pricer (CSV options), which lives at `../../downloads/luxibook/`.

Closed-source evaluation binaries. Matching `.sha256` files ship beside each
binary. **These files are not Apple-notarized and not Authenticode-signed.**

| File | Platform |
|------|----------|
| `luxirisk-macos-arm64` | macOS Apple Silicon |
| `luxirisk-linux-x86_64` | Linux x86_64 |
| `luxirisk-windows-x86_64.exe` | Windows x86_64 |

Also attached to GitHub Release **[`luxirisk-v0.2`](https://github.com/RegularJoe-CEO/LuxiDemo/releases/tag/luxirisk-v0.2)**.

First run: macOS right-click → Open; Windows SmartScreen → More info → Run anyway.
Always verify the digest. Calculation receipts use Ed25519 `lxr1_…` (see
[`../FORMULAS.md`](../FORMULAS.md)).
